heading: Regulations
lead: Not later than 1 year after May 21, 2008, the Commission shall issue final regulations to carry out this chapter.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective 18 months after May 21, 2008, see section 213 of Pub. L. 110–233, set out as a note under section 2000ff of this title.
